zh.line_break: 优先在语义短语或标点处断行；不要拆开数字+量词或固定词组

en.line_break: 在语义块之间换行，不将单词拆成两行

font_notice: 字体名称仅作为风格建议，不能假定宿主环境已安装或取得商业授权；优先使用平台可用且许可允许的字体。

text_render_pipeline.if: image tool can render reliable independent editable text overlay
text_render_pipeline.do: generate no-text base then typeset exact title as editable layer; verify exact glyphs

text_render_pipeline.if: image tool can render text but no independent overlay
text_render_pipeline.do: request exact title once; inspect glyphs and fix via image edit if available

text_render_pipeline.if: text fidelity is poor and no editing tools
text_render_pipeline.do: generate text-free base with reserved text space; return title coordinates and ready-to-paste text for manual overlay; do not claim complete thumbnail

poster.layout: one small-to-medium block; no forced title

reaction.layout: single title in negative space opposite face

question.layout: one hook phrase, optional single keyword highlight

discovery.layout: one evidence-focused headline; not on evidence target

versus.layout: two small party labels + optional short shared verdict

series.layout: one short headline + verified episode badge only

minimal.layout: zero text default, user title remains if explicitly supplied

overflow_strategy: use permitted negative space or enlarge text block
if still impossible: say so and ask permission to shorten; never silently drop text

screenshot_title_integration.exact_user_title: 绝对优先原文；允许断行但不删减、增加、改写原词；不得为了适合封面擅自制造新闻标题。
screenshot_title_integration.positioning: 先找截图真实负空间或局部建立低对比文字托底；拒绝标题压在复杂主体上或放到图片之外灰底。
screenshot_title_integration.hierarchy: 主标题是必需（用户给标题时）；小标签、副标题仅在用户提供、非事实性且有明确用途时可选。电影海报感不等于必须出现多行文案。
screenshot_title_integration.scene_protect: 保留人物脸、身体轮廓、主要车辆、证据区域的可见性。
screenshot_title_integration.mobile_check: 按实际发布平台缩小查看；不要用仅适合电脑大图的细字装饰。

platform_overrides.xiaohongshu: 竖版优先标题在上部/有可读负空间处，强主视觉但节制文字密度。
platform_overrides.bilibili: 剧情/氛围可少字；测评/攻略在用户内容支持时增加信息层级，不能机械加实机/评测标签。
platform_overrides.youtube: 横向16:9单个清晰主标题，不强制英文，不给标题添加编造的夸张结论。

v16_size_definition: block_height_pct is headline overall block height including line breaks, not a single line glyph height. font_size_h_ratio describes per-line font size for deterministic overlay tools.
v16_guardrails: 先使用用户原文逐字正确，再考虑标题设计
宽度溢出先按语义断行、分组视觉层级，再微调字号，禁止截断原文
有真实主体冲突时可镜像布局位置/切换备用布局，不可把标题盖脸、盖车头
专业海报与纪实型允许无副标题且不自动发明事实
字体、行距、描边百分比要以实际可用的工具为准，不承诺纯文生图可以逐像素控制
